About AstraLM
AstraLM is a sovereign on-device AI platform designed to run LLMs, multimodal vision models, and diffusion directly on your phone silicon. From deep reasoning to code execution, all computations occur strictly within device RAM.
37+
Curated On-Device Models
Optimized weights across DeepSeek-R1, Qwen 2.5, Gemma 2, and Stable Diffusion ready to download and run.

Cloud Network Traffic
Completely air-gapped execution. Your chats, prompts, and memory never touch a remote server.
99.8%
Quantized Precision Retention
Advanced 4-bit, 8-bit, and LiteRT quantization preserves full reasoning capabilities on lightweight silicon.
